newsitem.title: USA: U.S wholesale prices decline 0.4 percent in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S wholesale prices decline 0.4 percent in February.

text.p: Prices at the wholesale level tumbled in February, the Labor Department said on Friday, the latest indication that inflationay pressures have been largely wrung out of the economy.
The department said the Producer Price Index fell 0.4 percent after declining 0.3 percent in January. It was the first time since the autumn of 1994 that the index retreated two months in a row.
